Show the countdown in the status bar

Samsung shows other apps’ countdowns at the top of the screen only when this switch is on:

1. Open Settings → About phone → Software information.
2. Tap “Build number” 7 times, until the phone says Developer options are on (it may ask for your PIN).
3. Go back to Settings, open Developer options at the bottom of the list.
4. Search for “Live notifications” and turn on “Live notifications for all apps”.
5. Come back to Minhad: the countdown appears at the top of the screen.
